title: Boba Fett
description: After surviving the Sarlacc Pit on Tatooine, Boba Fett was taken in by Tusken Raiders. Fett became an honorary member of their tribe before they were wiped out by the Pyke Syndicate. Fett saved Fennec Shand, then recovered his armor from The Mandalorian, Din Djarin. Fett and Shand overthrew Bib Fortuna. Fett and his allies later defeated the Pykes.
